main.summary: Creates deterministic storage-block plans from staged logical transfer ranges.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Validate the staged logical ranges, order them by destination offset, and split them into deterministic storage blocks.
method.remarks: The ranges must provide contiguous coverage beginning at offset zero. Each range may be split into multiple blocks when its length exceeds . The resulting plan retains the source blob and source offset for every block and reports the total covered length.
method.param: Logical ranges and their staged source blob references. The ranges must be valid, contiguous, non-overlapping, and collectively begin at offset zero.
Maximum number of bytes allowed in an individual storage block. Must be positive and no greater than the storage limit.
method.returns: A deterministic plan whose blocks are ordered by destination offset and assigned stable block identifiers.
method.exception: Thrown when a range, source reference, blob length, or coverage sequence is invalid.
Thrown when the maximum block size is not positive or exceeds the storage limit.

method.name: CreateBlockID
method.summary: Create a deterministic Base64 block identifier from a zero-based block index.
method.param: Zero-based position of the block in the generated plan.

method.name: ValidateReference
method.summary: Validate one logical range reference before it is added to the block plan.
method.param: Logical range and staged source blob reference to validate.
Zero-based position used to identify the reference in validation errors.
method.exception: Thrown when the reference is missing or invalid, its source blob name is empty, or its source blob length does not match the logical range length.
